- ✅ Shared dependencies: @tanstack/react-query, @digilist/client-sdk, @xala/ds

**Pattern Identified:**
The web app splits vendors into separate chunks for better browser caching and parallel loading. When only SDK code changes, other vendor chunks remain cached.
